note: SMUD's 400-acre park around a 160-acre lake fed by the Folsom South Canal, 25 miles from downtown Sacramento. The 21 RV sites line the paved outer road along the park's southwestern rim, behind the tent sites and 100-150 m from the lake; a few are sold as water-view sites. Designated swimming beach. Boat trailers have been banned since March 14, 2025 to keep out the invasive golden mussel, and hand-launched craft are inspected on entry; boats are rented on weekends and holidays from Memorial Day to Labor Day. The lake holds bass (catch and release only), bluegill, redear sunfish and crappie, and rainbow trout are stocked from November through March. The Howard Ranch Trail is an easy seven-mile round trip across a working cattle ranch, so dogs stay home. The park also rents Jupes, and outside firewood is not allowed. --Claude
